title: Chapter 233
text:
Among the four continents of Blue Star, the Six Nations occupied the North, South, and West Continents. Andrea in the middle was once the main battlefield of the old era. It was heavily polluted, the environment was poor, and the air was filled with radiation. It was deserted and abandoned, and the Germinal Organization built it into their base camp.

Half a year ago, when Han Xiao sold the Germinal Organization information, it shocked the Six Nations and caused the Germinal Organization's bases to be destroyed. All along, the Germinal Organization had been relying on these 'nails' to make the Six Nations hesitate. Now that the threat was eliminated, the Six Nations had nothing to worry about.

The prelude to the expedition began.

War was not something that could be started easily, especially when the scale of the war almost covered the entire world. The mobilization of military forces and resources could only start the war when everything was in place.

After a few months of preparation, the expedition finally started on September 16th, 688 of the Galaxy Calendar.

More than a dozen large naval formations set off from their respective military ports at the same time. With the aircraft carrier as the core, they were accompanied by countless frigates and destroyers, carrying tens of thousands of soldiers. It was a mighty sight to behold.

The Six Nations had discussed the strategic layout and the joint operation. The chief commander of the navy was the top officer from Raylan, Lin Lin. He was a pure soldier, had no political leanings, was experienced, and had a reliable style. He was the commander that was unanimously chosen by the highest level of the Six Nations. Lin Lin commanded the naval fleet to attack Andrea from all directions, a full-scale invasion.

The Germinal Organization arranged positioning measures and military forces around the coastline, and they also sent out fleets and air forces to defend their control of the sea.

The first wave of battle was missiles.

The Germinal Organization made the first move and launched long-range missiles, wanting to destroy the Six Nations' navy. However, they were shot down by the anti-missile tracking missile array of the aircraft carrier in the sky. The aircraft carrier returned the favor and launched missiles toward Andrea. The Germinal Organization relied on the land-based anti-missile device to avoid the disaster.

Firing missiles at each other could not do anything to the two sides. The direction of the battle still depended on the result of the contact battle.

The fleets engaged in a fierce battle in Andrea's waters. The flames of war ignited on the blue sea. The two armies clashed, and the combined cannons spewed out flames more than ten meters long. The flames were blinding, and thick smoke billowed. Explosions occurred on the battleships one after another, and ships were sunk at any time.

Although the main characters of a large-scale battlefield were the various war weapons, the role of Supers could not be ignored. If no precautions were taken, a powerful Supers could slaughter an entire ship of soldiers and destroy the battleship from the inside by themselves. All kinds of strange Espers were causing havoc on the battlefield, and the existence of Supers made the battle full of variables. Fortunately, the Germinal Organization's Executive Officers were strong, and the Supers of the Six Nations were not weak either. Both sides had suffered losses, but they were able to restrain each other.

Since the main storyline of the war had been brought forward by Han Xiao, the players from the various factions who participated in the expedition quest could only watch. There was almost no room for them to interfere in the naval battle.

In his previous life, the players would have already charged forward. Now, the influence of the players on the battlefield had been reduced to the minimum by Han Xiao.

Their levels were really too low. If they rushed up, they would just be cannon fodder.

The naval commander of the Germinal Organization, Daloste, used to be a high-ranking naval officer of a destroyed country. The Germinal Organization fleet under his command was as fierce as a pack of wolves. However, the Six Nations knew when to advance and retreat. It was as if they knew the layout of the Germinal Organization like the back of their hand. After the battle, the Germinal Organization fleet suffered huge losses.

On the southern battlefield, Stardragon's [Long Star] and [Flying Dragon] fleets tore apart the formation. Hesla's [Scorching Sun], [Plunder Bird], and [Spear] fleets drove straight in and destroyed the island port that provided the Germinal Organization with supplies. The other four nations also had their own strategies on the battlefield.

Before the battle, Han Xiao had revealed the information of the Germinal Organization's headquarters to Stardragon, which gave the Six Nations an advantage in intelligence.

They had the upper hand on the battlefield, and it was all thanks to Han Xiao's intelligence contribution. The leaders of the various nations did not forget this point.

Daloste's flagship was sunk in the naval battle, and the cannonballs blew him into pieces. The deputy commander, Anser, took over the command immediately.

Facing the siege of the Six Nations' navy, Anser could not do much alone. In just three days, he lost a large area of the sea. In the end, he wisely gave up the fight for sea control and moved his troops back to the mainland to defend. The Germinal Organization was prepared to use Andrea's home ground advantage to fight against the Six Nations.

After obtaining the right to control the sea, the Six Nations sealed off the surrounding waters. Various fleets surrounded the Andrea Mainland and set up high-powered sonar that worked twenty-four hours a day to prevent submarines from attacking or escaping. It was like a net covering the entire Andrea Mainland. The entire Andrea Mainland was like a turtle in a jar, cutting off the Germinal Organization's escape route.

The aircraft carrier became a mobile air base, challenging the Germinal Organization's air supremacy. It bombed everywhere and fought with the Germinal Organization's air forces at the same time. Dropping nuclear bombs was the last resort, and it would not be used unless it was absolutely necessary.

The troop transport ships sent the ground troops to the coastline. The ground troops of the Six Nations finally set foot on Andrea, and a fierce battle broke out.

The result of the ground battle could determine the direction of the war. According to Han Xiao's intelligence, as long as the anti-missile military bases were destroyed, the aircraft carrier's missile lethality would be liberated, and the battle would be decided in one fell swoop.

The Germinal Organization had lost their escape route and was facing heavy encirclement. If this dragged on, their territory would be continuously breached, and they would be killed. If the Germinal Organization wanted to break out of this situation, they had to find other ways. The commanders of the Six Nations believed that the Germinal Organization must have other strategic plans in the dark. Both sides were testing each other's trump cards.

Anyone could see that the Germinal Organization was at a disadvantage. The Six Nations had held many analysis meetings internally, and they all agreed that the Germinal Organization had almost no chance of winning. The only thing that they had to pay attention to was the information that Han Xiao revealed about the Hand of Death system to prevent the Germinal Organization from acting out of desperation.

In order to remove the nuclear threat, the Six Nations sent out special agent teams to infiltrate the various military bases that controlled nuclear weapons according to Han Xiao's intelligence.

…

In the Germinal Organization's headquarters, the leader was listening to the battle report.

The upper echelons of the Germinal Organization were gloomy. The battle had just started, and the situation was already falling in their favor. Indeed, in terms of pure strength, the Germinal Organization could not withstand the combined attack of the Six Nations. Fortunately, they still had various plans and products that could be used as surprise troops, which should be very effective in the ground battle.

In his previous life, when the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization were at war, the situation was equal. With the bases in various continents, the Germinal Organization controlled the attention of the Six Nations, and their military strength on the battlefield was basically equal.

But now, the Germinal Organization was greatly weakened by Han Xiao, and the scales of victory seemed to be tilting toward the Six Nations. The situation was completely different from his previous life.

Everything was because of Han Xiao, the little butterfly!

No one knew how to win this battle, but the leader's calmness made everyone think that he had a plan.

"Port Holm, Port Mourning Bird, Port Temifa … all thirteen ports have been lost, and the Six Nations are continuously sending ground troops ashore. In the north, Raylan and Theseus are attacking Sunset Valley Base and Black Tree Base. If these two bases are taken, we will lose a portion of our missile silos. The other four countries are steadily advancing, breaking through the defense of Barker and Mu Haishan, heading toward the key bases. The enemy's goal is very clear — to remove all our missile and anti-missile bases. They actually know the details of the bases, so they definitely have important information on us …" The officer was sweating profusely as he reported.

"It's Zero." The leader's tone was calm, so calm that it was scary. He was already used to it.

This result confirmed his guess that Han Xiao had the 'clairvoyance' superpower. As long as Zero was not eliminated, he would always be a big problem for the organization. Intelligence was only useful when there was enough power. Unfortunately, Zero was moving between the Six Nations, making use of others to do the dirty work.

However, the Germinal Organization could not do anything about it. Zero was like a rat hiding from place to place. They hoped that Destiny's Child's prediction would be correct, and Zero would come to the headquarters to walk right into the trap. The leader had placed countless people around the headquarters. As long as he gave the order, they would form a huge encirclement that spanned thousands of miles.

In order to catch Zero, no amount of fanfare would be excessive.

Zero's strength was only above average, and it was very likely that he would come with helpers. Under such a large-scale encirclement, the leader was confident that no matter how many people Han Xiao brought, they would all die.

As for whether Zero had the clairvoyance ability and whether he would discover his trap, the leader had done an experiment. He had disrupted the military deployment and found that the Six Nations did not understand these changes. He could see that Han Xiao's' clairvoyance 'had limitations, at least not omniscient. The leader could only choose to believe in Destiny's Child.

As the passive party, he did not have much choice. He could only wait.

"Kill Zero, and we will have a chance of winning."
